purpose: experiment validity: real frame clock, input effectiveness, equal logical-frame exposure

window.reason: the v3.7.0 loop stopped at frames//2 = 900 decisions and let planning time become exposure time; with lag=1 the action schedule is a fixed grid and per-action exposure is exactly frameskip frames

clock.rollback_policy: ANOMALY_ROLLBACK, epoch += 1, episode is a technical failure, exposure clamped at 0 (never negative)
clock.left_game_policy: technical failure, not a shortened window
clock.timeout_policy: a wait deadline never counts as a reached frame

input.backend_reason: PostMessage fails menu navigation on this build (v3.7.0 live-v2 preregistration)
input.effective_probe: engine g_CurFrameInput readback per frame, two-frame settling
input.unresolved_policy: status unknown_interval with [send_frame, send_frame + effective_probe_frames]; no fabricated point estimate
input.release_policy: keys released in a finally block on every exit path
